Get paid anywhere. Pay everyone. One ledger.

NVXO Business Lite is one app where a small or mid-sized business accepts money in store, online and by invoice, pays sellers, staff and suppliers, and sees all of it in a single set of books. This page maps every module, every step and every screen from the three documents and the Figma export.

The common engine

Every request that moves money passes the same eight checks, in this order. A module only adds its own rules at check 5, which is why the modules below can stay short.

  1. AuthenticateApp session (JWT, 15-minute access, 30-day refresh) or API key. Expired or revoked is rejected.
  2. AuthoriseRole permission for the action, then the approval policy is evaluated.
  3. IdempotencyKey hashed with the body. Same key and body returns the stored response. Keys kept 24 h.
  4. ValidateRequired fields, types, ISO 4217 currency, amount above zero in minor units.
  5. Module rulesThe business rules of the module handling the request.
  6. Risk and complianceSanctions screening, velocity limits, tier limits, Travel Rule for crypto of €1,000 or more.
  7. Funds check and holdLedger hold for amount, fee and FX on outgoing money. Released on failure.
  8. Post and emitAtomic double-entry posting, status change, webhook, push or email, audit-log entry.

One state machine for everything

created→requires_action→processing→succeededfailedcancelled
payouts addreturnedrequests and invoices addexpired

Only forward transitions are allowed. Every transition stores the actor, the timestamp and the reason.

The ledger rule

Balances are never updated directly. A balance is the sum of posted entries, and available = posted − holds. A daily job reconciles the ledger against provider statements.

Sandbox and production

Every endpoint exists in both environments with identical paths. Only the host, the keys and the data differ: sandbox.api.nvxo.com/v1 with sk_test_ keys, api.nvxo.com/v1 with sk_live_ keys, plus regional hosts for data residency (eu, uk, us, in, br, sg, ae). Sandbox adds /test_helpers/* endpoints to force payment, payout, dispute and KYB outcomes and to advance test clocks. Live keys unlock only after KYB approval.

Who signs off what

Roles are assigned per business, so the same person can be Owner of one business and Accountant of another. Anything that moves money has a second pair of eyes.

Roles

OwnerFull control, transfers ownership
AdminEverything except ownership
FinancePayouts, bills, FX, reports
PayrollEmployees and pay runs
ApproverApproves within policy
AccountantRead and export
CashierPOS only, scoped to a store
DeveloperAPI keys and webhooks

Custom roles are allowed. Two-factor authentication is mandatory on first login for money-moving roles. Invites expire after 7 days. Only owners can assign the Admin role.

Sign-off points across the app

  • Bulk payout batchMaker submits, checkers approve per policy. The approver cannot be the maker. Approval link expires in 72 h. Release needs PIN or biometric.
  • Pay runPayroll maker plus Finance checker. Approval locks the run.
  • Vendor billRules by amount, vendor or department, sequential or parallel. Reminder after 24 h.
  • Vendor bank change48-hour cooling period, payee re-check, owner notified. Payments blocked until verified.
  • Inter-business transferAn approver from each business when policies apply.
  • POS refundManager PIN above the store threshold.
  • Switching businessPIN required when the user can move money in the target profile.
  • Owner transferCurrent owner PIN plus KYC of the new owner.
  • API paymentsAPI key plus approval policy replaces the in-app PIN. High-value payouts can require dashboard approval.

Roadmap and what it depends on

Delivery starts with what NVXO Pay already runs, so early merchants get value while acquiring and payout partners are contracted. Windows are the proposed ones from the functionality plan.

Phase 1 · Q1 to Q2 2027

Get paid and pay simply

Business accounts, KYB, business links and QR, invoicing with pay links, virtual IBAN matching, basic ledger with CSV export, single and bulk SEPA payouts, roles and approvals.

Gate to phase 2IBAN and inbound bank partner live. Manual Finance top-ups retired.
Phase 2 · Q3 to Q4 2027

Commerce and payroll

Online gateway and plugins, Tap to Pay, subscriptions, payroll runs and payslips, vendor bills, accounting sync, international bulk payouts, disputes.

Gate to phase 3Acquirer contract, payout webhooks, PCI attestation.
Phase 3 · 2028

Full finance stack

Terminals and multi-store POS, marketplace split payments, business cards and expenses, FX forwards, yield, e-invoicing countries, stablecoin settlement, cash-flow forecasting.

NeedsCard-issuing sponsor, custody provider, country partners.

Plans (indicative)

PlanForIncluded
Lite · freeSole tradersLinks, QR, 20 invoices a month, free internal transfers
Grow · low fixed feeSmall shops, online sellersGateway, POS, unlimited invoices, bulk payouts, 3 users
Scale · higher fee plus per employeeSMEs with staffPayroll, AP, approvals, accounting sync, cards, API

On top: per-transaction acceptance fees by method, per-line payout fees by rail, and an FX markup disclosed in every quote.

Target KPIs named in the plan

At least 95% of incoming payments auto-reconciled. Manual Finance interventions near zero per 1,000 transactions after phase 1. Low-risk merchants approved within 24 hours.
